philosophy.title: Teaching Philosophy
content: I seek to make learning relevant, meaningful, and collaborative in nature.
I aim to foster a culture that both challenges students and equips them with the support they need to meet those challenges.

content.title: Grading Interviews
content: Students participate in two 30 minute oral interviews throughout the semester.
These interviews are really a structured conversation that allows to students to demonstrate their knowledge.
They sound scary, but are actually very beneficial for both students and instructors.

content.title: Collaborative Learning
content: Collaboration is critical for computer sciene.
Learning should be a fun, interactive experience where you work alongside your instructor and peers.
